name: zc_companion_colours

tests.name: there is an AI companion embodied in the world

detail.note: identical PRIMARY, different SECONDARY. If nothing moves, the secondary channel is not reaching the glow surfaces at all -- which is what a mis-named material parameter looks like, and it looks exactly like a correct one that had no effect
identical SECONDARY, different PRIMARY. A near-black body against a white one must change the frame's luma; if it does not, the primary channel is not reaching the solid parts

tests.name: the two channels are independent, not one knob driving everything

detail.note: the glow's hue must answer to SECONDARY more than to PRIMARY. If the primary swings it just as hard, one colour is driving both channels and the founder's two controls are decorative
